subject: geography
title: National Parks of India
description: Major national parks with their locations and key features

content.overview: India has over 100 national parks protecting diverse ecosystems and wildlife.
keyPoints: Jim Corbett National Park (Uttarakhand): First national park (1936), tigers, elephants
Kaziranga National Park (Assam): One-horned rhinoceros, UNESCO World Heritage Site
Sundarbans National Park (West Bengal): Royal Bengal Tiger, mangrove forests, UNESCO site
Gir National Park (Gujarat): Asiatic lions, only place in world
Ranthambore National Park (Rajasthan): Tigers, leopards, historic fort
Bandhavgarh National Park (MP): Highest tiger density
Kanha National Park (MP): Tigers, barasingha (swamp deer)
Pench National Park (MP): Tigers, inspiration for Jungle Book
Nagarhole National Park (Karnataka): Tigers, elephants, leopards
Periyar National Park (Kerala): Elephants, tigers, lake
Valley of Flowers National Park (Uttarakhand): Alpine flowers, UNESCO site
Nanda Devi National Park (Uttarakhand): UNESCO site, biosphere reserve
Great Himalayan National Park (Himachal Pradesh): UNESCO site, snow leopards
Dachigam National Park (J&K): Hangul (Kashmir stag)
Hemis National Park (Ladakh): Snow leopards, highest altitude park
Desert National Park (Rajasthan): Great Indian Bustard
Sariska Tiger Reserve (Rajasthan): Tigers, leopards
Panna National Park (MP): Tigers, gharials
Satpura Tiger Reserve (MP): Tigers, leopards, sloth bears
Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve (Maharashtra): Tigers, leopards

mnemonics.trick: Uttarakhand: Corbett, Valley of Flowers, Nanda Devi, Rajaji | Assam: Kaziranga, Manas, Nameri, Orang | MP: Kanha, Bandhavgarh, Pench, Panna, Satpura | Rajasthan: Ranthambore, Sariska, Desert, Keoladeo | Gujarat: Gir, Blackbuck, Marine | Kerala: Periyar, Silent Valley, Eravikulam | Karnataka: Nagarhole, Bandipur, Bannerghatta | Tamil Nadu: Mudumalai, Indira Gandhi, Mukurthi | West Bengal: Sundarbans, Gorumara, Neora Valley | J&K: Dachigam, Hemis, Kishtwar | Ladakh: Hemis, Changthang
mnemonics.explanation: Remember national parks by state for quick recall

quiz.question: Which is the first national park of India?
quiz.explanation: Jim Corbett National Park (1936) is the first national park of India

quiz.question: Asiatic lions are found only in:
quiz.explanation: Asiatic lions are found only in Gir National Park, Gujarat

quiz.question: Sundarbans is famous for:
quiz.explanation: Sundarbans is famous for Royal Bengal Tigers and mangrove forests
